items.title: Customer inquiry on WW32 yield excursion
items.body:
Dear Jerry,

During incoming inspection this week we found a higher than usual fail rate on lot A123. Our data shows 1.8 percent, while your shipping report shows 0.3 percent.

Could you share the containment plan and the estimated date for the 8D report? We also need to know whether other lots from the same work week are affected.

Our line is still running, but we will have to stop it on Friday if we do not receive your reply.

Best regards,
Mark Chen
Quality Engineering, Northstar Memory
items.body_zh:
Jerry 您好：

本週來料檢驗時，我們發現批號 A123 的失效率高於平常。我們的數據是 1.8%，但貴司的出貨報告寫的是 0.3%。

可否提供圍堵對策，以及 8D 報告的預計完成日期？我們也需要知道同一個 WW 的其他批次是否受到影響。

我們的產線目前仍在運轉，但如果週五前沒收到回覆，就必須停線。

此致
Mark Chen
Northstar Memory 品質工程部

glossary.zh: 8D 報告（八大步驟問題解決報告）

key_patterns.en: Could you share ... and the estimated date for ...?
key_patterns.zh: 索取資料＋要求時程的標準句式
key_patterns.note: 客戶這樣問代表在要 commitment，回信必須給日期，寫「盡快」等於沒回答。

key_patterns.en: Our data shows X, while your report shows Y.
key_patterns.zh: 指出雙方資料落差的中性說法
key_patterns.note: 用 while 對比事實，不指控對方造假；焦點放在數字，不放在責任。

key_patterns.en: We will have to ... if we do not receive your reply.
key_patterns.zh: 軟性施壓的期限句
key_patterns.note: 這是最後通牒的禮貌版。看到這種句子代表當天就要回，即使只能先回「收到，明天給日期」。

questions.q: What is the customer actually asking for?
options: A price discount for the affected lot
A written apology from the supplier
A containment plan and a date for the 8D report
Replacement samples for evaluation
questions.explain_zh: 信裡最核心的一句是 Could you share the containment plan and the estimated date for the 8D report。其他選項信中都沒提到。

questions.q: Why does Mark mention 1.8 percent and 0.3 percent together?
options: To point out a discrepancy between the two sides' data
To show that the yield is improving
To explain how his test equipment works
To request a new specification limit
questions.explain_zh: 兩個數字並列是為了凸顯 discrepancy（資料落差）。回信時要先承認落差存在，再說明你會怎麼查，不要急著否認對方的數字。

questions.q: What will happen if there is no reply by Friday?
options: The customer will place a new order
The customer will stop their production line
The customer will scrap the material
The customer will visit the fab
questions.explain_zh: Our line is still running, but we will have to stop it on Friday。停線代表損失金額會開始累積，這封信的優先級是最高的。

items.title: Request for failure analysis samples
items.body:
Hi Jerry,

Thank you for the quick update yesterday. We would like to return four failing units for failure analysis.

Could you confirm the shipping address and the RMA number we should write on the box? We also need to know the expected turnaround time so that we can inform our customer.

If a cross-section is required, please let us know in advance, since we will then send eight units instead of four.

Thanks,
Anna
Supplier Quality, Northstar Memory
items.body_zh:
Jerry 您好：

謝謝您昨天迅速更新狀況。我們想寄回四顆失效品做失效分析。

可否確認寄送地址，以及外箱要寫的 RMA 編號？我們也需要知道預計的處理週期，好讓我們通知終端客戶。

如果需要做剖面分析，請提前告知，我們就會寄八顆而不是四顆。

謝謝
Anna
Northstar Memory 供應商品質部

key_patterns.en: Could you confirm A and B?
key_patterns.zh: 一次確認兩件事的簡潔問法
key_patterns.note: 回信時照順序逐項回答，客戶問兩件就回兩件，漏一件會被再問一次。

key_patterns.en: If X is required, please let us know in advance, since we will then ...
key_patterns.zh: 條件句＋提前告知的請求
key_patterns.note: since 後面說明為什麼要提前知道，讓對方理解這不是多問，而是會改變他們的動作。

questions.q: How many units will Anna send if a cross-section is needed?
options: Four
Six
Eight
Twelve
questions.explain_zh: we will then send eight units instead of four。這種數量條件在回信時要明確確認，避免收到數量不足無法分析。

questions.q: Why does Anna need the turnaround time?
options: To decide whether to pay for express shipping
To inform her own customer
To schedule a factory visit
To close the RMA immediately
questions.explain_zh: so that we can inform our customer。她背後也有客戶在等，所以給的日期一旦承諾就很難改。

questions.q: Which reply below answers the email completely?
options: "We will check and get back to you soon."
"Please send the units to our Hsinchu site. FA takes about ten working days, and a cross-section is not required at this stage."
"Thank you for your email. We are sorry for the inconvenience."
"The failure rate is only 0.3 percent, so analysis may not be necessary."
questions.explain_zh: 完整回覆＝地址＋處理週期＋是否需要剖面，三個問題全部回到。A 和 C 沒有資訊量，D 迴避了問題。

items.title: Escalation: the 8D report is overdue
items.body:
Dear Jerry,

I am following up on our request from WW33. The interim 8D report was committed for last Friday, but we have not received anything so far.

Our management reviewed the case this morning and asked me to escalate. To be clear, we are not questioning your technical work; the issue is that we cannot plan without a date we can rely on.

Please send the interim report by Wednesday, even if the root cause is not fully confirmed. A report that states what is known, what is still open, and when it will close is enough for us at this stage.

If Wednesday is not realistic, tell me today and give me a date that is.

Regards,
Mark Chen
Quality Engineering, Northstar Memory
items.body_zh:
Jerry 您好：

我在追蹤我們 WW33 提出的需求。8D 期中報告原本承諾上週五交，但到目前為止我們什麼都沒收到。

管理層今天早上檢視了這個案子，要求我升級處理。把話說清楚：我們不是在質疑貴司的技術工作，問題在於沒有一個可靠的日期，我們無法安排計畫。

請在週三前寄出期中報告，即使根本原因還沒完全確認也沒關係。一份說明「已知什麼、還有什麼未結、何時會結案」的報告，在現階段對我們就足夠了。

如果週三並不實際，今天就告訴我，並給我一個做得到的日期。

此致
Mark Chen
Northstar Memory 品質工程部

key_patterns.en: To be clear, we are not questioning ...; the issue is that ...
key_patterns.zh: 先降溫再指出真正問題
key_patterns.note: 客戶用這個句式時是在保護關係、但不放過事情。回信也要照做：先謝謝理解，再給日期。

key_patterns.en: A report that states what is known, what is still open, and when it will close is enough.
key_patterns.zh: 定義可接受的最低交付內容
key_patterns.note: 這句其實是幫你解套——不必等完整結論才回。期中報告的三段式結構可以直接沿用。

key_patterns.en: If X is not realistic, tell me today and give me a date that is.
key_patterns.zh: 要求對方主動提出可行日期
key_patterns.note: 最忌諱的回應是沉默。就算做不到，當天回一句「週五可以，週三不行」也遠好過不回。

questions.q: What is Mark's main complaint?
options: The technical analysis is wrong
A committed date was missed and no new date was given
The failure rate is too high
The supplier sent the wrong report format
questions.explain_zh: 他明說 we are not questioning your technical work，問題是承諾的日期跳票且沒有補上新日期。

questions.q: What does Mark accept as the minimum deliverable?
options: A confirmed root cause with full data
A phone call from the supplier's management
An interim report stating what is known, what is open, and the closing date
A replacement shipment
questions.explain_zh: 他直接寫出了可接受的最低內容：已知／未結／何時結案。這是寫期中報告最安全的三段結構。

questions.q: Which reply best matches what the customer asked for?
options: "We are still analysing and will update you as soon as possible."
"Wednesday is difficult. We will send the interim report on Friday WW35 with the containment status and the open items."
"Sorry for the delay. The furnace tool was down last week."
"We will send the full 8D report once the root cause is confirmed."
questions.explain_zh: 客戶要的是「做不到就給可行日期」。B 直接給了新日期與內容範圍。A 沒有日期，C 只有藉口，D 等於拒絕交期中報告。

items.title: 8D interim report: containment section
items.body:
D3 Containment Actions

On 12 August we placed a lot hold on all material processed on furnace F02 between WW30 and WW32. In total, 46 lots are affected, of which 12 have already been shipped.

For the shipped material, we asked the customer to quarantine the remaining stock. Two lots had already entered their production line; both were screened at incoming inspection with no additional failures found.

For material still in the fab, we added a temporary burn-in step before final test. This screening does not remove the root cause, but it prevents suspect units from reaching the customer while the investigation continues.

Containment will stay in place until the corrective action is verified on three consecutive production lots.
items.body_zh:
D3 圍堵措施

8 月 12 日，我們對 WW30 至 WW32 期間經過 F02 爐管的所有材料下了批次扣留。受影響批次共 46 批，其中 12 批已出貨。

已出貨的部分，我們請客戶隔離剩餘庫存。其中兩批已投入客戶產線，這兩批都在來料檢驗階段做了篩選，沒有發現額外失效。

仍在廠內的材料，我們在終測前加了一道臨時的高溫老化測試。這道篩選並不能移除根本原因，但可以在調查期間避免可疑品流到客戶端。

圍堵措施會持續到矯正措施在連續三個量產批上驗證通過為止。

key_patterns.en: In total, N lots are affected, of which M have already been shipped.
key_patterns.zh: 先給總數再拆出已出貨數
key_patterns.note: 客戶最想知道的永遠是「有多少已經到我這裡」。of which 讓你一句話交代兩個數字。

key_patterns.en: This screening does not remove the root cause, but it prevents ...
key_patterns.zh: 誠實說明圍堵的極限
key_patterns.note: 主動講出「這只是圍堵、不是解決」反而建立信任；藏起來被客戶問出來就變成隱瞞。

key_patterns.en: Containment will stay in place until ... is verified on three consecutive lots.
key_patterns.zh: 定義解除圍堵的客觀條件
key_patterns.note: 解除條件要寫成可驗證的數字（連續三批），不要寫 until the issue is solved。

questions.q: How many affected lots had already been shipped?
questions.explain_zh: 46 lots are affected, of which 12 have already been shipped。46 是總數，12 是已出貨數。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the temporary burn-in step?
options: To remove the root cause of the failure
To screen out suspect units while the investigation continues
To reduce the test cost
To qualify a new furnace tool
questions.explain_zh: 報告明說 does not remove the root cause, but it prevents suspect units from reaching the customer。圍堵＝擋住，不等於解決。

questions.q: When will the containment actions be removed?
options: After the customer approves the 8D report
After WW32 material is fully shipped
After the corrective action is verified on three consecutive production lots
After the burn-in step is automated
questions.explain_zh: 最後一句就是解除條件。寫 8D 時這一句一定要有，否則客戶會一直問「圍堵要做到什麼時候」。

items.title: 8D D4/D5: root cause and corrective action
items.body:
D4 Root Cause

Tool commonality analysis showed that all 46 affected lots passed through furnace F02. Chamber pressure logs for the same period show a slow upward drift of 4 percent, which stayed inside the alarm limit but outside the process window used during qualification.

The drift changed the film thickness at the wafer edge. Cross-section analysis on three failing die confirmed a thinner tunnel oxide at the edge, which is consistent with the read disturb signature seen at wafer sort.

We reproduced the failure by running a split at the drifted pressure. The split yield matched the excursion lots within 0.4 points, so the mechanism is considered confirmed.

D5 Corrective Action

The pressure alarm limit will be tightened from plus or minus 8 percent to plus or minus 3 percent, with automatic tool shutdown when the limit is crossed. The change is effective from WW35 on all furnaces of the same type.
items.body_zh:
D4 根本原因

機台共通性分析顯示，46 個受影響批次全部經過 F02 爐管。同期的腔體壓力記錄顯示有 4% 的緩慢上飄，這個飄移仍在警報界限內，卻已超出認證時使用的製程窗口。

這個飄移改變了晶圓邊緣的薄膜厚度。三顆失效晶粒的剖面分析確認邊緣的穿隧氧化層偏薄，這與 wafer sort 觀察到的讀取干擾特徵一致。

我們以飄移後的壓力做了一組分組實驗，成功重現失效。該分組的良率與異常批次相差在 0.4 個百分點以內，因此判定機制已確認。

D5 矯正措施

壓力警報界限將從 ±8% 收緊至 ±3%，並在超出時自動停機。此變更自 WW35 起適用於所有同型爐管。

key_patterns.en: X stayed inside the alarm limit but outside the process window.
key_patterns.zh: 區分「沒觸發警報」與「超出製程窗口」
key_patterns.note: 這句是很多 8D 的關鍵轉折：監控沒響不代表製程沒跑掉。客戶最常追問的就是這一點。

key_patterns.en: ..., which is consistent with the ... signature seen at ...
key_patterns.zh: 把物理證據連回失效特徵
key_patterns.note: consistent with 是留有餘地的說法（相符，但不宣稱唯一解），比 proves 安全且更專業。

key_patterns.en: We reproduced the failure by running a split at ... so the mechanism is considered confirmed.
key_patterns.zh: 以重現實驗作為結論的依據
key_patterns.note: 8D 的 D4 沒有重現實驗就只是推測。寫出重現條件與吻合程度（0.4 points）最有說服力。

questions.q: Why was the pressure drift not caught earlier?
options: The pressure sensor was broken
The drift stayed inside the alarm limit
The logs were not recorded
The tool was not in production
questions.explain_zh: stayed inside the alarm limit but outside the process window。警報設得太寬，所以沒響。這也正是 D5 收緊界限的理由。

questions.q: What evidence confirmed the failure mechanism?
options: A customer complaint from the same work week
A supplier certificate for the furnace tool
A split experiment that reproduced the yield loss
A simulation of the tunnel oxide
questions.explain_zh: We reproduced the failure by running a split ... matched within 0.4 points。重現才算確認，剖面只是佐證。

questions.q: What exactly changes in the corrective action?
options: The furnace tool is replaced
The alarm limit is tightened and the tool shuts down automatically
The wafer edge die are scrapped by default
The qualification is repeated every work week
questions.explain_zh: from plus or minus 8 percent to plus or minus 3 percent, with automatic tool shutdown。矯正措施要寫成具體可稽核的規格變更。

questions.q: Which sentence would be too strong for a D4 section?
options: The data is consistent with a thinner tunnel oxide at the edge.
The split result matched the excursion lots within 0.4 points.
This proves that pressure drift is the only possible cause.
Tool commonality analysis showed all affected lots passed through F02.
questions.explain_zh: 在 8D 裡宣稱 the only possible cause 幾乎不可能被證明，客戶只要找到一個反例就會推翻整份報告。用 consistent with、considered confirmed 比較安全。

items.title: FA report summary: edge ring failures
items.body:
Summary

Four units returned from the customer were analysed between 5 and 14 August. All four failed the same read operation at high temperature.

Electrical testing narrowed the failure down to two word lines in the same block. Optical inspection found no visible defect, so the units were prepared for cross-section.

The cross-section showed a thinner oxide layer at the die edge. The wafer map for the parent lots shows a clear edge ring, which rules out a random particle defect and points to a process step that affects the whole wafer edge.

We recommend that the device team check the anneal step, since the edge ring pattern matches the temperature profile of furnace F02.

Open item: two more units are still in queue for cross-section; the result is expected in WW36.
items.body_zh:
摘要

客戶退回的四顆樣品於 8 月 5 日至 14 日完成分析。四顆都在高溫下同一個讀取動作失效。

電性測試把失效縮小到同一個 block 內的兩條 word line。光學檢查沒有發現可見缺陷，因此送去做剖面。

剖面顯示晶粒邊緣的氧化層偏薄。母批的晶圓分佈圖呈現明顯的邊緣環，這排除了隨機顆粒缺陷，並指向影響整個晶圓邊緣的某道製程。

我們建議元件團隊檢查退火製程，因為邊緣環的分佈與 F02 爐管的溫度分佈相符。

未結項目：另有兩顆樣品仍在剖面排隊中，結果預計 WW36 出爐。

key_patterns.en: Electrical testing narrowed the failure down to ...
key_patterns.zh: 描述定位過程的動詞
key_patterns.note: FA 報告的敘事順序固定：narrow down → rule out → point to。照這個順序寫，讀者不會迷路。

key_patterns.en: ..., which rules out A and points to B.
key_patterns.zh: 一句同時排除與指向
key_patterns.note: rules out 與 points to 成對出現，是 FA 報告最省字的寫法。

key_patterns.en: Open item: ... the result is expected in WW36.
key_patterns.zh: 把未結事項單獨列出
key_patterns.note: 未結項目一定要獨立一段並附日期，否則客戶會以為報告已經完整。

questions.q: What did the optical inspection find?
options: A particle on the die surface
Nothing visible
A crack in the package
A thinner oxide layer
questions.explain_zh: Optical inspection found no visible defect。氧化層偏薄是後面剖面才看到的，不是光學檢查的結果。

questions.q: Why does the edge ring pattern matter?
options: It shows the failures are random
It proves the customer mishandled the units
It rules out a random particle defect
It means only one die per wafer failed
questions.explain_zh: 分佈形態是 FA 最有力的線索：有規律的分佈代表系統性製程問題，隨機分佈才是顆粒缺陷。

questions.q: What is still unfinished in this report?
options: The electrical testing of all four units
The cross-section of two additional units
The wafer map analysis
The customer's incoming inspection
questions.explain_zh: Open item 那一段：two more units are still in queue for cross-section，預計 WW36。

items.title: FA report: read disturb investigation
items.body:
Background

The customer reported single-bit failures after long read-intensive operation. The units passed final test and the failures appeared only in the field, which suggested a use-condition-dependent mechanism rather than a screening escape.

Method

We applied one million read cycles on the same word line at 85 degrees Celsius and monitored the threshold voltage distribution of the neighbouring pages after every one hundred thousand cycles.

Result

The distribution of the adjacent page shifted upward by 120 millivolts, and the raw bit error rate rose from 3E-5 to 8E-4. The shift is a classic read disturb behaviour and is fully recovered after an erase, which confirms that the cells are not physically damaged.

Conclusion

The parts meet the endurance and retention specifications. The failures occur because the customer's read count per block exceeds the value assumed in our qualification. We propose a joint review of the usage model before any design change is considered.
items.body_zh:
背景

客戶回報在長時間大量讀取後出現單一位元失效。這些樣品都通過終測，失效只在現場出現，顯示這是與使用條件相關的機制，而不是測試漏檢。

方法

我們在 85°C 下對同一條 word line 施加一百萬次讀取，每十萬次量測一次鄰近 page 的臨界電壓分佈。

結果

鄰近 page 的分佈往上位移了 120 mV，原始位元錯誤率從 3E-5 上升到 8E-4。這個位移是典型的讀取干擾行為，而且在 erase 之後完全恢復，證實記憶胞並未受到物理性損傷。

結論

這批產品符合耐久度與資料保存力規格。失效之所以發生，是因為客戶每個 block 的讀取次數超過我們認證時所假設的數值。我們建議在考慮任何設計變更之前，先共同檢視使用模型。

key_patterns.en: The failures appeared only in the field, which suggested ... rather than ...
key_patterns.zh: 用觀察推出機制方向
key_patterns.note: rather than 後面放你要排除的假設。工程英文裡「A 而非 B」的對比句比單講 A 更有說服力。

key_patterns.en: The shift is fully recovered after an erase, which confirms that the cells are not physically damaged.
key_patterns.zh: 以可逆性證明沒有永久損傷
key_patterns.note: 可逆＝沒壞，這是 disturb 類問題最關鍵的一句話，能直接把責任範圍講清楚。

key_patterns.en: We propose a joint review of the usage model before any design change is considered.
key_patterns.zh: 把球丟回去但保持合作語氣
key_patterns.note: 當問題出在客戶的使用條件時，不要寫 this is not our problem；用 joint review 讓對方有台階下。

questions.q: Why does the report say this is not a screening escape?
options: Because the units failed at final test
Because the failures appeared only after long field use
Because only one customer reported the issue
Because the bit error rate was below spec
questions.explain_zh: The units passed final test and the failures appeared only in the field。測試時是好的、用久了才壞，指向使用條件相關的機制。

questions.q: What does the full recovery after erase prove?
options: The test equipment was miscalibrated
The endurance spec is too loose
The cells are not physically damaged
The customer's read count is acceptable
questions.explain_zh: which confirms that the cells are not physically damaged。可逆的位移代表電荷被干擾，而不是元件損毀。

questions.q: What is the report's position on responsibility?
options: The product is out of spec and will be replaced
The product meets spec, but the customer's read count exceeds the qualified assumption
The failure is caused by a process drift in the fab
No conclusion can be drawn from the data
questions.explain_zh: The parts meet the endurance and retention specifications ... exceeds the value assumed in our qualification。立場明確但語氣合作，這是這類報告的標準寫法。

questions.q: Which phrase keeps the tone cooperative rather than defensive?
options: "This is not our problem."
"The customer used the product incorrectly."
"We propose a joint review of the usage model."
"No design change will be made."
questions.explain_zh: joint review 把問題變成雙方一起解的題目。前兩個選項在正式報告裡等於指責客戶，會讓案子升級。

items.title: Trial run summary: new anneal recipe
items.body:
Purpose

The trial run was carried out to evaluate the new anneal recipe with a tighter pressure control before we roll it out to all furnaces.

Scope

Three lots were processed in WW34 on furnace F05. One control lot used the current recipe.

Result

Sort yield of the trial lots was 94.1 percent, compared with 91.8 percent for the control lot. No new failure modes were observed. The edge ring pattern seen in the WW32 excursion did not appear in any of the trial lots.

Next step

We will run three more lots in WW35 to confirm that the result is repeatable. If the yield stays above 93 percent, we will request approval to release the recipe to production in WW36.
items.body_zh:
目的

本次試產是為了評估壓力控制更嚴的新退火配方，作為全爐管推行前的驗證。

範圍

WW34 於 F05 爐管投了三個批次，另有一個對照批使用現行配方。

結果

試產批的 sort yield 為 94.1%，對照批為 91.8%。沒有觀察到新的失效模式。WW32 異常事件看到的邊緣環，在任何一個試產批上都沒有出現。

下一步

我們會在 WW35 再投三個批次，確認結果可重現。若良率維持在 93% 以上，將申請核准於 WW36 放行到量產。

key_patterns.en: X was 94.1 percent, compared with 91.8 percent for the control lot.
key_patterns.zh: 有對照組的數據比較句
key_patterns.note: 報良率一定要附對照組，否則 94.1% 本身沒有意義。compared with 後面放基準。

key_patterns.en: If the yield stays above X, we will request approval to ...
key_patterns.zh: 條件式的下一步
key_patterns.note: 把放行條件先寫成數字，主管才知道要批准什麼；也保護自己不被要求提前放行。

questions.q: How much did the trial recipe improve sort yield?
options: 0.9 points
2.3 points
3.1 points
6.2 points
questions.explain_zh: 94.1 減 91.8 等於 2.3 個百分點。英文用 points（百分點），不要說 percent，否則意思會變成相對成長率。

questions.q: Why is a control lot included in the trial?
options: To increase the total output
To give a baseline for comparison
To test a second new recipe
To satisfy the customer audit
questions.explain_zh: 對照批的作用就是提供基準。沒有基準的良率數字在會議上一定會被挑戰。

questions.q: What must happen before the recipe goes into production?
options: The customer must approve the anneal step
Three more lots must confirm the result is repeatable
The furnace tool must be replaced
A cross-section must be completed
questions.explain_zh: Next step 段落：再投三批確認可重現，且良率維持 93% 以上才申請放行。

items.title: Spec change notice: tightened chamber pressure limit
items.body:
Dear Partner,

This notice informs you of a process change that will take effect from WW35.

Change: the chamber pressure alarm limit on our anneal furnaces will be tightened from plus or minus 8 percent to plus or minus 3 percent. The tool will shut down automatically when the limit is crossed.

Reason: the wider limit allowed a slow drift that was linked to the WW32 yield excursion. The tighter limit removes that risk.

Impact on the product: none. Form, fit and function remain unchanged, and no electrical parameter in the datasheet is affected. Throughput may drop by about 1 percent because of additional tool downtime.

Qualification: three production lots processed under the new limit passed all reliability stress tests. The data package is attached.

Please confirm receipt of this notice by 30 August. If we do not hear from you, we will assume the change is accepted.

Best regards,
Process Integration Team
items.body_zh:
合作夥伴您好：

本通知說明一項自 WW35 起生效的製程變更。

變更內容：退火爐管的腔體壓力警報界限將從 ±8% 收緊至 ±3%，超出時機台會自動停機。

變更原因：原本較寬的界限容許了一段緩慢漂移，該漂移與 WW32 的良率異常有關。收緊界限可移除此風險。

對產品的影響：無。外形、配合與功能均不變，規格書上的電性參數也不受影響。因機台停機時間增加，產出可能下降約 1%。

驗證：以新界限投產的三個量產批已通過所有可靠度應力測試，資料包如附件。

請於 8 月 30 日前確認收到本通知。若未收到回覆，我們將視為本變更已被接受。

此致
製程整合團隊

glossary.zh: 外形、配合與功能（產品是否實質改變的判準）

key_patterns.en: Impact on the product: none. Form, fit and function remain unchanged.
key_patterns.zh: 變更通知的核心保證句
key_patterns.note: 客戶收到 PCN 只關心一件事：產品會不會變。這句話講不清楚，後面一定被追問。

key_patterns.en: Please confirm receipt of this notice by [date]. If we do not hear from you, we will assume ...
key_patterns.zh: 設定回覆期限與預設結果
key_patterns.note: 這是正式通知的標準結尾。對外發文時要注意：預設接受的寫法必須事先在合約或品質協議中允許。

questions.q: What is the reason for the change?
options: To increase throughput
To remove the drift risk linked to the WW32 excursion
To meet a new customer specification
To qualify a new furnace supplier
questions.explain_zh: Reason 段落直接說明：寬界限容許漂移，而漂移與 WW32 異常有關。

questions.q: What is the impact on the product?
options: Electrical parameters will shift slightly
The datasheet will be revised
No impact on form, fit and function
The package size changes
questions.explain_zh: Impact on the product: none。產出下降 1% 是對工廠的影響，不是對產品的影響，兩者不要混為一談。

questions.q: What happens if the customer does not reply by 30 August?
options: The change is cancelled
The change is treated as accepted
The notice is sent again
The shipment is put on hold
questions.explain_zh: If we do not hear from you, we will assume the change is accepted。這種預設條款要看清楚，收到別人的通知時也一樣。

items.title: Reply to customer audit finding on traceability
items.body:
Finding 3: Traceability records for reworked wafers were incomplete for two of the ten lots sampled.

Our response

We accept the finding. The two lots were reworked during a system upgrade in WW28, when rework events were recorded manually and the operator did not enter the second rework step.

We would like to clarify one point: the missing entries affect the record, not the material. Physical traceability was maintained through the lot travel card, and we were able to reconstruct the full history of both lots from the tool logs. Evidence is attached in Appendix B.

Corrective action

Since WW31, manual entry has been disabled. Every rework event is now written automatically by the tool, and a lot cannot move to the next step until the record is complete. An internal audit of 200 lots processed after WW31 found no missing entries.

We propose to close this finding at the next quarterly review, and we welcome a follow-up audit of the new system at any time.
items.body_zh:
缺失事項 3：抽樣的十個批次中，有兩個批次的重工履歷紀錄不完整。

我方回覆

我們接受此項缺失。這兩個批次是在 WW28 系統升級期間重工的，當時重工事件以人工記錄，操作員漏填了第二道重工步驟。

我們想澄清一點：缺漏影響的是紀錄，不是材料本身。實體履歷透過批次流程卡完整維持，我們也能從機台日誌重建兩個批次的完整歷史，佐證資料如附錄 B。

矯正措施

自 WW31 起，人工輸入已被停用。每一次重工事件都由機台自動寫入，且紀錄未完成前批次無法流到下一站。我們針對 WW31 之後的 200 個批次做了內部稽核，未發現任何缺漏。

我們建議在下次季度審查時結案此缺失，並隨時歡迎針對新系統進行追蹤稽核。

key_patterns.en: We accept the finding.
key_patterns.zh: 先接受缺失，不辯解
key_patterns.note: 稽核回覆的第一句就要表態。先承認再澄清，順序反過來會被讀成狡辯。

key_patterns.en: We would like to clarify one point: the missing entries affect the record, not the material.
key_patterns.zh: 接受之後才做範圍澄清
key_patterns.note: clarify 不等於 disagree。把影響範圍講清楚（紀錄 vs 材料）能避免缺失被無限放大。

key_patterns.en: We propose to close this finding at ... and we welcome a follow-up audit.
key_patterns.zh: 主動提結案並開放複查
key_patterns.note: 主動邀請複查是最強的可信度訊號，前提是你的系統真的改好了。

questions.q: How does the supplier open its response?
options: By disputing the finding
By accepting the finding
By asking for more time
By blaming the operator
questions.explain_zh: 第一句就是 We accept the finding。稽核回覆的黃金順序是：接受 → 澄清範圍 → 矯正措施 → 提議結案。

questions.q: What is the point of the clarification paragraph?
options: To show that the audit was wrong
To limit the scope: the records were incomplete, but the material history is known
To request a waiver for the two lots
To explain that the system upgrade failed
questions.explain_zh: affect the record, not the material，並附上可從機台日誌重建的佐證。這是縮小影響範圍，不是否認缺失。

questions.q: Which evidence best supports closing the finding?
options: The operator has been retrained
The two lots were shipped without complaints
An internal audit of 200 lots after WW31 found no missing entries
The system upgrade is now complete
questions.explain_zh: 稽核員只認可以量化驗證的證據。200 批零缺漏是數據，「已再教育」則無法驗證有效性。

questions.q: Why does the supplier invite a follow-up audit?
options: Because the customer contract requires it
To delay closing the finding
To signal confidence that the new system works
To avoid paying a penalty
questions.explain_zh: 主動開放複查是信心的訊號。但只有在系統真的改好時才能這樣寫，否則複查失敗會更嚴重。

items.title: Reply: containment plan and 8D schedule
items.body:
Dear Mark,

Thank you for your email. Here is where we stand.

Containment: all lots processed on the same tool between WW30 and WW32 are on hold. Of the 46 affected lots, 12 have shipped to your site. We kindly ask you to quarantine the remaining stock until our screening result is available on 24 August.

Schedule: the interim 8D report will reach you by Wednesday 24 August. The confirmed root cause will follow in WW36.

On the data gap you raised, we acknowledge the difference between your incoming result and our final test data, and we are checking the correlation between the two test conditions.

I will send a short update every Monday until the case is closed.

Best regards,
Jerry
items.body_zh:
Mark 您好：

感謝您的來信，以下是目前的狀況。

圍堵：WW30 至 WW32 期間經過同一台機台的所有批次都已扣留。46 個受影響批次中，有 12 批已出貨到貴司。在我們 8 月 24 日的篩選結果出來前，敬請先隔離剩餘庫存。

時程：8D 期中報告會在 8 月 24 日（週三）前送達，確認的根本原因會在 WW36 提出。

關於您提到的資料落差，我們確認貴司來料檢驗結果與我方終測資料之間確實有差異，正在檢視兩種測試條件之間的相關性。

在本案結案前，我每週一都會發一則簡短更新。

此致
Jerry

key_patterns.en: Thank you for your email. Here is where we stand.
key_patterns.zh: 回信的開場：直接進入狀態說明
key_patterns.note: 不要寫 We are sorry for the inconvenience 開場。客戶要的是狀態，不是道歉。

key_patterns.en: We kindly ask you to ... until ... is available on {date}.
key_patterns.zh: 請對方配合動作＋明確解除條件
key_patterns.note: 請客戶做事一定要附上「做到什麼時候為止」，否則會被當成無限期停用。

key_patterns.en: I will send a short update every Monday until the case is closed.
key_patterns.zh: 主動承諾更新節奏
key_patterns.note: 定期更新的承諾能大幅減少客戶追問，也讓你掌握溝通節奏。

questions.q: What does Jerry ask the customer to do?
options: Return all shipped material
Quarantine the remaining stock until 24 August
Stop the production line immediately
Re-test every unit at their own cost
questions.explain_zh: quarantine the remaining stock until our screening result is available on 24 August。隔離＋明確解除日期。

questions.q: How does Jerry handle the data gap the customer raised?
options: He denies the customer's numbers
He ignores the point
He acknowledges the gap and says the correlation is being checked
He blames the customer's test equipment
questions.explain_zh: we acknowledge the difference ... and we are checking the correlation。先承認落差存在，再說明處理方式。

questions.q: What makes this reply stronger than a generic one?
options: It apologizes several times
It gives specific dates and a fixed update rhythm
It is very short
It avoids mentioning the shipped lots
questions.explain_zh: 24 August、WW36、every Monday —— 三個時間點讓客戶可以排自己的計畫，這封信才算完整。

items.title: Customer pushes back on the root cause
items.body:
Dear Jerry,

We have reviewed your interim report. Two points are not clear to us.

First, you state that the pressure drift is the root cause, but the drift started in WW28 while the yield loss only appeared in WW32. Could you explain the four-week delay?

Second, your report says the corrective action is effective from WW35. What protects the material built between WW32 and WW35?

We are not asking you to rush the analysis. We are asking for a report that answers these two questions before we close the case internally.

Regards,
Mark
items.body_zh:
Jerry 您好：

我們看過貴司的期中報告，有兩點不清楚。

第一，報告指出壓力漂移是根本原因，但漂移從 WW28 就開始，良率損失卻到 WW32 才出現。可否說明這四週的落差？

第二，報告說矯正措施自 WW35 起生效。那 WW32 到 WW35 之間生產的材料由什麼來保護？

我們不是要貴司趕分析，而是希望在我們內部結案前，報告能回答這兩個問題。

此致
Mark

key_patterns.en: Two points are not clear to us.
key_patterns.zh: 先宣告數量再逐項質疑
key_patterns.note: 英文商務信很愛先給數量（two points / three items），讀信的人一開始就知道要回幾件事。

key_patterns.en: You state that X, but Y. Could you explain the ... ?
key_patterns.zh: 指出邏輯落差的標準質疑句
key_patterns.note: 客戶用 you state ... but ... 時，他已經自己比對過資料了。回信必須正面解釋，不能跳過。

key_patterns.en: We are not asking you to rush. We are asking for ...
key_patterns.zh: 澄清訴求，避免被誤解成催促
key_patterns.note: 這個對比句能把焦點從速度拉回品質，你回信時也可以反向使用。

questions.q: What is the first technical gap Mark points out?
options: The drift and the yield loss started at different times
The wrong tool was analysed
The sample size is too small
The report has no data
questions.explain_zh: drift started in WW28 while the yield loss only appeared in WW32 —— 時間對不上是最常見的 8D 破口。

questions.q: What is Mark's second question really about?
options: The cost of the corrective action
The material built before the fix took effect
The furnace supplier
The next audit date
questions.explain_zh: What protects the material built between WW32 and WW35 —— 矯正措施生效前的空窗期一定要有圍堵覆蓋，否則報告不完整。

questions.q: What tone does Mark use?
options: Angry and threatening
Firm but not hostile
Casual and friendly
Apologetic
questions.explain_zh: We are not asking you to rush —— 他刻意降溫，但要求沒有放鬆。這是專業客戶施壓的標準寫法。

items.title: 8D D2: problem description
items.body:
D2 Problem Description

What: single-bit read failures at high temperature on 128-gigabit NAND devices.

When: first detected at wafer sort on 8 August, covering material processed between WW30 and WW32.

Where: two wafers per lot, with failures concentrated in the outer ten millimetres of the wafer.

How much: 46 lots affected, average fail rate 1.8 percent against a baseline of 0.3 percent.

How detected: the automated excursion monitor flagged lot A123 when the bin 7 fail rate crossed the alarm limit.

Not affected: material from the other three furnace types processed in the same period shows no shift.
items.body_zh:
D2 問題描述

什麼問題：128Gb NAND 元件在高溫下出現單一位元讀取失效。

何時發現：8 月 8 日於 wafer sort 首次發現，涵蓋 WW30 至 WW32 期間生產的材料。

何處發生：每批兩片晶圓，失效集中在晶圓外緣十毫米以內。

影響多少：46 個批次受影響，平均失效率 1.8%，基準值為 0.3%。

如何偵測：自動異常監控在 bin 7 失效率超過警報界限時標記了批號 A123。

未受影響：同期經過其他三種爐管的材料沒有出現偏移。

key_patterns.en: What / When / Where / How much / How detected / Not affected
key_patterns.zh: D2 的六欄結構
key_patterns.note: 照這六欄寫，客戶就沒有理由退回你的 D2。最容易漏的是最後一欄 Not affected。

key_patterns.en: average fail rate 1.8 percent against a baseline of 0.3 percent
key_patterns.zh: 數字要成對出現：實測值 vs 基準
key_patterns.note: against 前面是現況、後面是基準。只給一個數字讀者無法判斷嚴重程度。

key_patterns.en: Not affected: material from ... shows no shift.
key_patterns.zh: 主動界定沒問題的範圍
key_patterns.note: 寫出「哪些沒事」能防止客戶把整個產品線都扣住，是保護出貨最重要的一句。

questions.q: Why is the 'Not affected' line important?
options: It makes the report longer
It limits the scope so unaffected material can keep shipping
It is required by the customer's format
It proves the root cause
questions.explain_zh: 界定沒問題的範圍能避免客戶把整條產品線都停掉。這一欄常被忽略，但商業影響最大。

questions.q: How was the problem first detected?
options: A customer complaint
A routine audit
The automated excursion monitor flagged a lot
A engineer noticed it by chance
questions.explain_zh: the automated excursion monitor flagged lot A123。內部自動偵測到，比客戶先發現，這在 D2 是加分項。

questions.q: What is the fail rate compared with the baseline?
options: 0.3 percent vs 1.8 percent baseline
1.8 percent vs 0.3 percent baseline
1.8 percent vs 7 percent baseline
46 percent vs 0.3 percent baseline
questions.explain_zh: average fail rate 1.8 percent against a baseline of 0.3 percent。against 後面永遠是基準。

items.title: 8D D6/D7: verification and prevention
items.body:
D6 Verification of the Corrective Action

Three production lots were processed under the tightened pressure limit in WW35. Sort yield was 94.1, 93.8 and 94.3 percent, all above the 93 percent release criterion. No edge ring pattern appeared on any wafer map. Reliability stress on 77 units per condition showed no failures after 500 hours.

Based on this evidence, the containment screening was removed on 5 September.

D7 Prevention of Recurrence

The tightened limit and the automatic shutdown were applied to all 14 furnaces of the same type, not only to the tool that drifted. The process FMEA was updated to raise the detection rating for slow drift from 6 to 3, and the maintenance interval for the pressure sensor was shortened from 12 months to 6 months.

A quarterly review of all alarm limits against the qualified process windows has been added to the standard procedure.
items.body_zh:
D6 矯正措施驗證

WW35 以收緊後的壓力界限投了三個量產批。Sort yield 分別為 94.1%、93.8%、94.3%，全部高於 93% 的放行標準。所有晶圓分佈圖都沒有出現邊緣環。每個條件 77 顆的可靠度應力測試在 500 小時後沒有失效。

依據上述證據，圍堵篩選已於 9 月 5 日移除。

D7 防止再發

收緊後的界限與自動停機已套用到全部 14 台同型爐管，而不只是發生漂移的那一台。製程 FMEA 已更新，把緩慢漂移的偵測度評分從 6 降到 3，壓力感測器的保養週期也從 12 個月縮短為 6 個月。

標準程序中新增了每季一次的檢視，比對所有警報界限與認證過的製程窗口。

key_patterns.en: Sort yield was A, B and C percent, all above the D percent release criterion.
key_patterns.zh: 逐批列數字＋對照放行標準
key_patterns.note: 驗證段落不要只寫「通過」。列出每一批的數字，讀者才能自己判斷邊際有多少。

key_patterns.en: Based on this evidence, the containment screening was removed on {date}.
key_patterns.zh: 以證據連結到解除圍堵的動作
key_patterns.note: 解除圍堵是有商業風險的決定，一定要把依據與日期寫在同一句。

key_patterns.en: ... was applied to all 14 furnaces of the same type, not only to the tool that drifted.
key_patterns.zh: 橫向展開的標準寫法
key_patterns.note: not only to ... 這個對比句直接回答客戶最愛問的「其他機台呢」。

questions.q: What justified removing the containment screening?
options: The customer requested it
Three verification lots exceeded the release criterion with no edge ring
The furnace was replaced
The 500-hour stress was skipped
questions.explain_zh: 三批都高於 93% 放行標準、無邊緣環、可靠度無失效——三項證據齊備才移除圍堵。

questions.q: What does the FMEA update change?
options: The severity rating for the failure
The detection rating for slow drift, from 6 to 3
The occurrence rating for pressure loss
The customer's specification
questions.explain_zh: raise the detection rating ... from 6 to 3。偵測度數字越低代表越容易被抓到，所以是改善。

questions.q: Which item best demonstrates prevention rather than correction?
options: Removing the screening step
Running three verification lots
Adding a quarterly review of all alarm limits
Measuring sort yield
questions.explain_zh: D7 要的是「制度上不會再發生」，季度性檢視全部警報界限才是系統性防呆，其餘都是這一次的處置。

questions.q: How many furnaces received the change?
questions.explain_zh: all 14 furnaces of the same type。77 是可靠度樣本數，3 是驗證批數，數字要各歸各位。

items.title: FA report: no failure found
items.body:
Summary

The customer returned six units reported as failing at system level. All six passed our full electrical test at room temperature and at 85 degrees Celsius.

We repeated the test using the customer's read pattern and still could not reproduce the failure. The units were then stressed for 168 hours at high temperature; no parameter shifted beyond the specification.

Conclusion: no failure found on the returned units. This does not mean the customer's observation is wrong. It means the failure depends on a condition that is not present in our test environment.

Proposal: we would like to receive the system log around the failure event, and, if possible, run our test script on the customer's board. Without the operating condition, further analysis on our side will not converge.
items.body_zh:
摘要

客戶退回六顆在系統端被判定失效的樣品。六顆在室溫與 85°C 下都通過我方完整的電性測試。

我們以客戶的讀取模式重測，仍無法重現失效。這些樣品接著在高溫下做了 168 小時的應力測試，沒有任何參數超出規格。

結論：退回品未發現失效。這不代表客戶的觀察有誤，而是代表該失效取決於我方測試環境中不存在的某個條件。

建議：我們希望取得失效事件前後的系統日誌，若可行，也希望在客戶的板子上跑我方的測試腳本。缺少實際操作條件，我方單獨分析不會收斂。

key_patterns.en: This does not mean the customer's observation is wrong. It means ...
key_patterns.zh: NFF 報告最關鍵的兩句
key_patterns.note: 寫 no failure found 時，如果不加這兩句，客戶會直接讀成「你在說我亂報」。

key_patterns.en: Without the operating condition, further analysis on our side will not converge.
key_patterns.zh: 說明為什麼需要對方提供資料
key_patterns.note: 把「我需要資料」講成「沒有資料這件事不會有結果」，對方比較願意配合。

key_patterns.en: we would like to receive X, and, if possible, run Y
key_patterns.zh: 分成必要與加分兩層的請求
key_patterns.note: if possible 讓對方可以只答應第一項，比一次要五樣東西成功率高。

questions.q: What does 'no failure found' mean in this report?
options: The customer made a mistake
The units are good and can be shipped again
The failure could not be reproduced in the supplier's test environment
The test equipment was broken
questions.explain_zh: 報告特別澄清：NFF 是「在我的環境重現不出來」，不是「你搞錯了」。這個分寸決定客戶會不會翻臉。

questions.q: What does the supplier ask for?
options: More returned units
The system log and, if possible, access to the customer's board
A waiver
An extension of the deadline
questions.explain_zh: system log 是必要項，跑腳本是加分項。請求分層能提高被接受的機率。

questions.q: Which stress condition was applied?
options: 168 hours at high temperature
1,000 hours at room temperature
500 cycles of program and erase
No stress was applied
questions.explain_zh: stressed for 168 hours at high temperature。168 小時是業界常用的一週應力條件。

items.title: FA report: correlating sort data with customer returns
items.body:
Objective

To determine whether the units returned by the customer share a common origin in the fab.

Method

We traced the 18 returned units back to their parent lots using the assembly traceability database. Sort data for those lots was then compared with the fab average for the same period.

Findings

Fourteen of the 18 units originate from four lots, all processed on the same furnace within a three-day window. The remaining four units come from lots with no common tool.

For the four suspect lots, the bin 7 fail rate at sort was 2.4 percent against a fab average of 0.4 percent. The failing die in those lots sit at the wafer edge, which matches the location of the returned units on their wafer maps.

Interpretation

The correlation is strong but not complete. The four unrelated units suggest a second, lower-rate mechanism that this analysis does not explain. We recommend keeping the case open until those four units are cross-sectioned.
items.body_zh:
目的

判斷客戶退回的樣品在廠內是否具有共同來源。

方法

我們透過封裝履歷資料庫，把 18 顆退回品追溯回其母批，再將這些批次的針測資料與同期廠內平均值比較。

發現

18 顆中有 14 顆來自四個批次，這四批都在三天內經過同一台爐管。其餘四顆來自沒有共同機台的批次。

四個可疑批次在針測的 bin 7 失效率為 2.4%，廠內平均為 0.4%。這些批次的失效晶粒位於晶圓邊緣，與退回品在晶圓分佈圖上的位置相符。

判讀

相關性很強但並不完整。那四顆無關聯的樣品顯示還存在第二個發生率較低的機制，本次分析無法解釋。建議在那四顆完成剖面前先不要結案。

key_patterns.en: Fourteen of the 18 units originate from four lots, all processed on ...
key_patterns.zh: 把樣本拆成有關聯與無關聯兩群
key_patterns.note: N of M 的結構在資料敘述裡到處都是，說的時候記得先講小數再講總數。

key_patterns.en: The correlation is strong but not complete.
key_patterns.zh: 誠實描述證據強度
key_patterns.note: 工程英文常用 strong / weak / not complete 這種分級。硬說 100% 相關，之後被打臉的代價更高。

key_patterns.en: We recommend keeping the case open until ...
key_patterns.zh: 建議不結案並給條件
key_patterns.note: 客戶通常急著結案。你要擋下來就必須寫清楚「還缺哪一筆證據」。

questions.q: How many returned units share a common tool?
questions.explain_zh: Fourteen of the 18 units originate from four lots, all processed on the same furnace。14 是有關聯的，4 是無關聯的。

questions.q: What does the bin 7 comparison show?
options: The suspect lots are six times worse than the fab average
The suspect lots match the fab average
The fab average is 2.4 percent
Bin 7 is not related to the failure
questions.explain_zh: 2.4% 對 0.4%，正好是六倍。會議上被問「差多少」時，能直接講出倍數比報數字更有力。

questions.q: Why does the report recommend keeping the case open?
options: The customer asked for more time
Four units are not explained by the identified mechanism
The traceability database was incomplete
The wafer maps were not available
questions.explain_zh: 四顆無關聯樣品代表可能有第二個機制。只解釋 78% 的樣品就結案，是最容易復發的錯誤。

questions.q: Which sentence shows appropriate caution?
options: The correlation is strong but not complete.
All returned units come from one furnace.
The root cause is confirmed.
No further analysis is required.
questions.explain_zh: 資料只支持到這個程度，就只能寫到這個程度。過度宣稱是工程報告最常見的失分點。

items.title: Trial run summary: tightened screening recipe
items.body:
Purpose

To evaluate whether a shorter screening recipe can catch the same defects as the current one, so that test cost can be reduced.

Scope

Two lots were split: half of each lot ran the current 40-minute recipe, and half ran the proposed 25-minute recipe.

Result

The short recipe caught 96 percent of the units that the long recipe rejected. The four percent that escaped were all marginal units near the pass limit.

Test time per wafer dropped from 40 to 25 minutes, which frees about 90 tester hours per week.

Recommendation

We do not recommend releasing the short recipe yet. A 4 percent escape rate on marginal units is acceptable for internal material but not for customer shipments. We propose a second trial with an adjusted pass limit before making a decision.
items.body_zh:
目的

評估較短的篩選配方能否抓到與現行配方相同的缺陷，以降低測試成本。

範圍

兩個批次做了分組：每批一半跑現行 40 分鐘配方，一半跑提案中的 25 分鐘配方。

結果

短配方抓到了長配方所剔除單位中的 96%。漏掉的 4% 全部是接近合格線的邊際品。

每片晶圓的測試時間從 40 分鐘降到 25 分鐘，每週約可釋出 90 小時的測試機台時間。

建議

目前不建議放行短配方。邊際品 4% 的漏檢率對內部材料可以接受，但不適用於客戶出貨。建議調整合格線後再做第二次試產，再行決策。

key_patterns.en: The short recipe caught 96 percent of the units that the long recipe rejected.
key_patterns.zh: 用「相對於現行方法」描述新方法的效果
key_patterns.note: 新舊比較要有共同基準，否則 96% 這個數字沒有意義。

key_patterns.en: We do not recommend releasing X yet.
key_patterns.zh: 明確給出否定建議
key_patterns.note: 工程報告最怕結論模糊。不建議就寫不建議，然後補上要補什麼才能再談。

key_patterns.en: ... is acceptable for internal material but not for customer shipments.
key_patterns.zh: 依用途分級判斷可接受度
key_patterns.note: 同一個數字在不同用途下結論不同，把這一層講出來能顯示你懂風險分級。

questions.q: What is the main benefit of the short recipe?
options: Higher yield
About 90 tester hours saved per week
Better reliability
Lower defect density
questions.explain_zh: frees about 90 tester hours per week。降低測試時間的價值要換算成產能，才會被主管採納。

questions.q: Why is the recommendation negative?
options: The time saving is too small
A 4 percent escape rate is not acceptable for customer shipments
The trial used only one lot
The tester was not qualified
questions.explain_zh: 4% 漏檢對內部可接受、對客戶不可接受。結論要綁用途，不能只看數字大小。

questions.q: What is proposed as the next step?
options: Release the recipe immediately
Abandon the idea
A second trial with an adjusted pass limit
Buy more testers
questions.explain_zh: a second trial with an adjusted pass limit。否定建議之後一定要給下一步，否則專案就停在那裡。

items.title: Trial run summary: new tester platform
items.body:
Purpose

To qualify a second tester platform so that final test capacity is not limited to a single vendor.

Method

The same 3,000 units were tested twice: first on the current platform, then on the new one. We compared the pass and fail decisions unit by unit.

Result

Agreement between the two platforms was 99.7 percent. Nine units passed on the current platform but failed on the new one; two units showed the opposite result.

All nine units were re-measured on a bench setup. Eight were genuinely marginal, which means the new platform is slightly stricter rather than wrong. One unit showed a contact problem on the new platform's socket.

Next step

We will replace the socket and repeat the correlation on 1,000 units. If agreement stays above 99.5 percent, we will release the platform for production in WW42.
items.body_zh:
目的

驗證第二套測試平台，使終測產能不受限於單一供應商。

方法

同一批 3,000 顆樣品測兩次：先用現行平台，再用新平台，並逐顆比對合格與不合格的判定。

結果

兩平台的判定一致率為 99.7%。有九顆在現行平台合格、在新平台不合格；另有兩顆結果相反。

那九顆全部在桌上型量測設備上重測。其中八顆確實是邊際品，代表新平台只是判定較嚴，而不是判錯；另一顆是新平台插座的接觸問題。

下一步

我們會更換插座，並以 1,000 顆重做相關性驗證。若一致率維持在 99.5% 以上，將於 WW42 放行至量產。

key_patterns.en: The same 3,000 units were tested twice: first on X, then on Y.
key_patterns.zh: 相關性驗證的標準描述
key_patterns.note: 強調 same units 是重點。用不同樣品比較，數字再漂亮也沒有意義。

key_patterns.en: ... which means the new platform is slightly stricter rather than wrong.
key_patterns.zh: 區分「較嚴」與「錯誤」
key_patterns.note: 這個區分決定要不要調整新平台的判定界限，是很專業的一句話。

key_patterns.en: If agreement stays above 99.5 percent, we will release ...
key_patterns.zh: 把放行條件寫成數字
key_patterns.note: 先講好門檻，之後就不會有人用「感覺還行」來推動放行。

questions.q: Why were the same units tested on both platforms?
options: To save cost
So the comparison is not affected by unit-to-unit variation
Because the customer required it
To increase the sample size
questions.explain_zh: 相關性驗證必須用同一批樣品，否則分不出差異來自平台還是來自樣品本身。

questions.q: What did the bench re-measurement show?
options: The new platform is wrong
Eight units were genuinely marginal and one had a socket contact issue
All nine units were good
The current platform is too strict
questions.explain_zh: 八顆是真的邊際、一顆是插座接觸。分清楚哪些是判定差異、哪些是硬體問題才知道要改什麼。

questions.q: What is the release criterion?
options: 99.7 percent agreement on 3,000 units
99.5 percent agreement on the repeat correlation
Zero disagreement
Approval from the tester vendor
questions.explain_zh: If agreement stays above 99.5 percent。門檻要寫在報告裡，而且比第一次的實測值略低才合理。

items.title: Spec change notice: datasheet parameter update
items.body:
Dear Partner,

This notice informs you of a datasheet update planned for WW40.

Change: the standby current maximum will be revised from 100 microamperes to 120 microamperes at 85 degrees Celsius. All other parameters remain unchanged.

Reason: the current limit was set before the process transfer to our second fab. Data from 24 production lots shows that the population is centred at 78 microamperes with a three-sigma value of 116 microamperes. The revised limit reflects the actual distribution and removes unnecessary yield loss.

Impact: no change to form, fit or function. Devices already shipped are not affected, since all of them were tested against the original 100 microampere limit.

Qualification: reliability data for material at the upper end of the new range is attached in Appendix A.

This is a specification relaxation. Please review it against your system margin and confirm your position by 20 September. If your design cannot accept the revised limit, contact us before that date and we will discuss a dedicated screening flow.
items.body_zh:
合作夥伴您好：

本通知說明一項預計於 WW40 生效的規格書更新。

變更內容：待機電流上限將由 85°C 下的 100 微安培修訂為 120 微安培，其餘參數不變。

變更原因：原上限是在製程移轉到第二廠之前訂定的。24 個量產批的資料顯示，母體中心值為 78 微安培，三倍標準差值為 116 微安培。修訂後的上限反映實際分佈，可移除不必要的良率損失。

影響：外形、配合與功能均不變。已出貨的產品不受影響，因為它們都是以原本的 100 微安培上限測試過的。

驗證：新範圍上緣材料的可靠度資料如附錄 A。

本次為規格放寬。請對照貴司的系統餘裕檢視，並於 9 月 20 日前確認立場。若貴司設計無法接受修訂後的上限，請於該日前與我們聯繫，我們會討論專屬的篩選流程。

key_patterns.en: This is a specification relaxation. Please review it against your system margin.
key_patterns.zh: 主動點名這是放寬並提醒對方檢查
key_patterns.note: 放寬對供應商有利、對客戶可能不利。主動說破反而建立信任，藏起來被抓到就是誠信問題。

key_patterns.en: Devices already shipped are not affected, since all of them were tested against the original limit.
key_patterns.zh: 切割已出貨品與未來出貨品
key_patterns.note: 規格變更信一定要回答「我手上的貨怎麼算」，否則客戶會要求全面重驗。

key_patterns.en: If your design cannot accept the revised limit, contact us before that date and we will discuss ...
key_patterns.zh: 提供不同意時的備援方案
key_patterns.note: 給出 opt-out 路徑能讓對方安心簽核，也避免整個變更被否決。

questions.q: What kind of change is this?
options: A specification tightening
A specification relaxation
A package change
A price change
questions.explain_zh: 上限從 100 放寬到 120 微安培，對供應商有利。信中主動點明 relaxation 是負責任的寫法。

questions.q: Why is the limit being revised?
options: The product got worse
The original limit was set before the process transfer and does not match the actual distribution
The customer requested it
A new tester was installed
questions.explain_zh: 母體中心 78、三倍標準差 116，原本 100 的上限太靠近分佈，造成不必要的良率損失。

questions.q: What should a customer do if the new limit is unacceptable?
options: Reject the shipment
Contact the supplier before 20 September to discuss a dedicated screening flow
Change their own datasheet
Nothing; the change is mandatory
questions.explain_zh: 信裡給了 opt-out 路徑與期限。收到這類通知時，如果你的系統餘裕不夠，一定要在期限前回覆。

items.title: Reply to an audit finding on calibration records
items.body:
Finding 2: Three of the twelve measurement tools sampled had calibration certificates that expired during the audit period.

Our response

We accept the finding. The three tools are bench multimeters used in the failure analysis lab, not in production test.

Root cause: calibration reminders were sent to a shared mailbox that was retired during an IT migration in WW26. The reminders were generated but never reached an owner.

Impact assessment: we reviewed all measurements taken with these three tools between the expiry dates and the audit. All were comparison measurements against a reference unit, and none were used as the basis for a pass or fail decision or for data reported to a customer. Details are in Appendix C.

Corrective action: calibration reminders now go to named individuals with a backup approver. Since WW34, a tool with an expired certificate is automatically locked out of the lab booking system.

We consider the risk contained and propose closing this finding after your review of Appendix C.
items.body_zh:
缺失事項 2：抽樣的十二台量測設備中，有三台的校正證書在稽核期間已過期。

我方回覆

我們接受此項缺失。這三台是失效分析實驗室使用的桌上型萬用電表，並非量產測試設備。

根本原因：校正提醒被寄到一個共用信箱，而該信箱在 WW26 的 IT 移轉中已停用。提醒有產生，但從未送達任何負責人。

影響評估：我們檢視了這三台設備在過期日至稽核期間所做的全部量測。這些都是與參考件的比較性量測，沒有任何一筆被用來做合格與否的判定，也沒有作為對客戶回報資料的依據，細節見附錄 C。

矯正措施：校正提醒現已改寄給具名的個人，並設有備援簽核者。自 WW34 起，證書過期的設備會自動被實驗室預約系統鎖定。

我們認為風險已受控，建議在貴司檢視附錄 C 後結案本缺失。

key_patterns.en: The three tools are bench multimeters used in the failure analysis lab, not in production test.
key_patterns.zh: 第一時間界定影響範圍
key_patterns.note: 接受缺失之後立刻講清楚是哪一類設備。這一句能把稽核員的擔憂縮小一個量級。

key_patterns.en: none were used as the basis for a pass or fail decision or for data reported to a customer
key_patterns.zh: 影響評估的關鍵結論句
key_patterns.note: 稽核員真正在意的是「有沒有影響到出貨判定」。直接回答這個問題，不要繞路。

key_patterns.en: a tool with an expired certificate is automatically locked out of the booking system
key_patterns.zh: 用系統性防呆取代人為提醒
key_patterns.note: 把矯正措施做成系統性阻擋，比「加強教育訓練」有效十倍，稽核員也吃這一套。

questions.q: What was the root cause of the expired certificates?
options: The tools were never calibrated
Reminders went to a shared mailbox that was retired
The calibration vendor closed
The lab manager ignored the reminders
questions.explain_zh: 提醒有發出但沒人收到。找到「訊息斷在哪裡」比責怪個人更接近真正的根因。

questions.q: Why does the impact assessment matter most to the auditor?
options: It shows the tools are expensive
It answers whether any pass or fail decision was affected
It lists the tool serial numbers
It proves the lab is busy
questions.explain_zh: 稽核員關心的是產品放行有沒有被影響。影響評估寫不到這一點，就等於沒寫。

questions.q: Which corrective action is the strongest?
options: Sending reminders to named individuals
Retraining the lab staff
Automatically locking expired tools out of the booking system
Reviewing past measurements
questions.explain_zh: 系統性阻擋不依賴人記得做事。矯正措施能做成自動化就不要做成流程規定。

questions.q: What does the supplier propose at the end?
options: To extend the audit
To close the finding after the auditor reviews Appendix C
To replace all measurement tools
To postpone the response
questions.explain_zh: 主動提結案並綁定一個明確的前提（檢視附錄 C），比空等對方決定更有效率。
